external_alignment_research.decision: Reuse identifiers for established operations/data/formats; retain local representation-state and governance semantics.
Adopt PROV-O relation semantics and qualified influence where role/time is needed.
Reuse the S-P-O-Q pattern while retaining scKG revision, scope, evidence assessment, and governance requirements.
Search and reuse RO/OBO relations before minting; local relations need explicit domain/range and mapping review.
Use an RO-Crate profile for exchange packaging later; do not make RO-Crate the internal scientific statement model.

external_alignment_status: Historical research preserved as unapproved mapping proposals, not imported or newly verified external ontology axioms.

identity_policy.endpoint_rule: The two resources are endpoints, never IdentityAssertion itself.
identity_policy.alias_of: Same identity under namespace-aware aliases requires review, not name similarity.
identity_policy.equivalent_to: Same entity type and same declared scope; symmetric within scope, not transitively merged.
identity_policy.fork_of: SoftwareProject to SoftwareProject, asymmetric and nontransitive; no assay/organism qualifiers.
identity_policy.supersedes: Same revision family and stable identity; reject self-supersession and cycles.
identity_policy.deprecated_by: Deferred; multiple successors possible; deprecation alone does not establish replacement.

provenance_policy: One optional was_derived_from relation; derives_from merges into it. Activity/Agent references remain opaque external IDs in core; no wholesale PROV-O import.
